findings.highlight: The desolate wasteland that the man obtained by fighting for others.
findings.evidenceJa: 他人の為に戦い続けた男が手に入れた、他人のいない一面の荒野。
findings.governingReading: A man who fought continuously for others obtained an unbroken wasteland with no other people in it.
findings.explanation: The wasteland loses the people-for-people contrast.

findings.highlight: obtained a miracle with his own blood.
findings.evidenceJa: 血を流しながら成し得た奇蹟
findings.governingReading: The ordinary man achieves a miracle through effort while shedding blood.
findings.explanation: A miracle achieved while bleeding becomes a miracle obtained with blood.

findings.highlight: They will only hurt by how they changed.
findings.evidenceJa: 変わり果てたその在り方に、胸を痛めるだけなんだから。
findings.governingReading: Both the one who sees his past self and the one who sees his future self can only feel heartache at what that self has become.
findings.explanation: The symmetrical pain of both selves becomes malformed English.

findings.highlight: to give his body after death
findings.evidenceJa: 死後の自分を差し出して
findings.governingReading: He enters the bargain by offering what he will be after death—his continuing self as a Guardian.
findings.explanation: Archer offers his posthumous self to the World but English offers his body.

findings.highlight: saved hundreds of lives.
findings.evidenceJa: 百人程度の命を救ったんだ。
findings.governingReading: The initial miracle saves about a hundred people; Archer believes later Guardian service will save tens of thousands more.
findings.explanation: Roughly one hundred saved lives becomes several hundred.

findings.highlight: In the land where the ones he wanted to save were already dead
findings.evidenceJa: 救いたかった筈の人間が死に絶えた破滅の地で
findings.governingReading: On a land of ruin where the humans he meant to save had died out, Archer kills still more people.
findings.explanation: Humanity’s extinction on a ruined land is weakened to people already being dead.

findings.highlight: I am the bone of my sword.
findings.evidenceJa: 体は剣で出来ている。
findings.governingReading: The verse states in the present that his body is made of swords.
findings.explanation: A body made of swords becomes the bone of one sword.

findings.highlight: Steel is my body, and fire is my blood.
findings.evidenceJa: 血潮は鉄で　心は硝子。
findings.governingReading: The parallel attributes are blood like iron and a heart like glass.
findings.explanation: Iron blood and a glass heart become a steel body and fiery blood.

findings.highlight: I have created over a thousand blades.
findings.evidenceJa: 幾たびの戦場を越えて不敗。
findings.governingReading: The verse says he crossed battlefields again and again without defeat.
findings.explanation: Crossing countless battlefields undefeated becomes creating a thousand blades.

findings.highlight: Unknown to Death,
findings.evidenceJa: ただの一度も敗走はなく、
findings.governingReading: He did not flee a battlefield in defeat even once.
findings.explanation: Never once retreating in defeat becomes being unknown to death.

findings.highlight: nor known to Life.
findings.evidenceJa: ただの一度も理解されない。
findings.governingReading: Not once was he understood by others.
findings.explanation: Never being understood becomes being unknown to life.

findings.highlight: Have withstood pain to create many weapons.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼の者は常に独り　剣の丘で勝利に酔う。
findings.governingReading: He is always alone, drunk on victory upon the hill of swords.
findings.explanation: Solitude and intoxication with victory become enduring pain to make weapons.

findings.highlight: Yet, those hands will never hold anything.
findings.evidenceJa: 故に、生涯に意味はなく。
findings.governingReading: The verse draws its conclusion: therefore his lifetime had no meaning.
findings.explanation: A life judged meaningless becomes hands that hold nothing.

findings.highlight: I will believe in my path like he used to do.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の信じた道を貫き通す。
findings.governingReading: For as long as she is Archer’s Master, Rin will follow through on the path she believes in, as his former self did.
findings.explanation: Rin’s commitment to carry her path through becomes merely believing in it.

findings.highlight: The first thing I notice when I wake up from my slumber are the sensations in my limbs.
findings.evidenceJa: まず気になったのが手足の感覚だった。
findings.governingReading: The first thing that concerns her on waking is the sensation in her limbs.
findings.explanation: Rin’s awakening sentence has broken subject-verb agreement.

findings.highlight: my handcuffs and shackles are magecraft-resistant
findings.evidenceJa: 手錠や足枷は抗魔術がかけられていて
findings.governingReading: Anti-magecraft has been placed on the handcuffs and ankle shackles, disrupting Rin’s circuits and preventing magical-energy generation.
findings.explanation: Applied anti-magecraft becomes an inherent resistance of the restraints.

findings.highlight: The shadow of the pillar.
findings.evidenceJa: 柱の陰。
findings.governingReading: Rin locates Archer concealed in or behind the pillar’s shadow, seated on rubble without coming near her.
findings.explanation: Archer’s concealment behind a pillar becomes the pillar’s shadow as an object.

findings.highlight: He is really a calm assassin now.
findings.evidenceJa: 今のあいつは本当に、冷徹な“掃除屋”だった。
findings.governingReading: Archer has lost his former intimacy and now looks like a cold, merciless “cleaner,” echoing a Guardian’s role in clearing disasters.
findings.explanation: A coldly ruthless cleanup man becomes a calm assassin.

findings.highlight: I take a breath and stare at the man in the shadows.
findings.evidenceJa: それを一息で呑み込んで、強く、影になった男を見据えた。
findings.governingReading: After accepting in one breath that her words may end their bond, Rin fixes the shadowed man with a strong gaze.
findings.explanation: Rin swallowing the consequence and fixing Archer with a strong gaze becomes taking another breath and staring.

findings.highlight: I'm saved by having a guy like him.
findings.evidenceJa: ああいうヤツがいてもいいんだって救われてる
findings.governingReading: Rin is saved by the thought that Shirou must be as he is and that someone like him is allowed to exist.
findings.explanation: Existential affirmation of people like Shirou becomes Rin being saved by possessing one.
